name: DescriptionList
label: Description list
description: Terms and their values for review screens, receipts, and account details, stacked, in two columns, or in a grid.

props.name: items
props.description: The entries, in order. Or compose `DescriptionListItem` children instead.

props.name: children
props.description: `DescriptionListItem` children, for a list written out by hand.

props.name: layout
props.description: `stacked` puts each term above its value; `inline` sets term and value in two columns and stacks them when the list is narrow; `grid` lays stacked entries out in `columns`.

props.name: columns
props.description: How many columns the `grid` layout uses at full width, 1 to 4. Fewer show as the list narrows.

props.name: size
props.description: The type size: `default` the paragraph face, `compact` the small paragraph face for dense panels.

props.name: termWidth
props.description: How much of the row the term column takes in the `inline` layout: a quarter, a third or a half.

props.name: align
props.description: Where values sit: `end` lines amounts up against the far edge.

props.name: emptyValue
props.description: What an empty value shows. Defaults to "Not set".

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The copy button's accessible name, given the entry's term when it is text and an empty string when it is not. Defaults to "Copy <term>", or "Copy".

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: The copy button's accessible name for a moment after a copy. Defaults to "Copied".

props.name: onValueCopy
props.description: Called after a value is put on the clipboard, so a host can confirm it or count it. Only reaches a list rendered from a client component.

props.name: details
props.description: The value. Empty (null, undefined or an empty string) shows the list's `emptyValue`.

props.name: term
props.description: The term: what the value is ("Account number", "Due date").

props.name: action
props.description: A trailing control for this value: an Edit button, a link.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Offer a copy button: `true` copies the value when it is text, a string copies that string (the unformatted account number behind a formatted one).

props.name: children
props.description: The value, as children. `details` wins when both are set.
